api-reference/args.title: ARG API
api-reference/args.description: The /api/args prefix manages the retrieval, creation, and interaction with ARGs (Alternate Reality Games).

api-reference/auth.title: Authentication API
api-reference/auth.description: The WARG platform uses Google OAuth 2.0 via Passport.js for all authentication.

api-reference/users-and-sessions.title: Users & Sessions API
api-reference/users-and-sessions.description: Endpoints under /api/users and /api/sessions handle social graphs, library tracking, and active gameplay session initialization.

architecture-and-design/design-principle.title: Design Principles and Colour System
architecture-and-design/design-principle.description: The visual language of the WARG Platform should support exploration rather than compete with it. Every design decision should help players navigate, understand, and enjoy the experience without unnecessary complexity.

database/schema.title: Database Schema
database/schema.description: The WARG platform relies on a MySQL database, extensively using spatial extensions (SRID 4326 / WGS 84) to manage real-world coordinates and geographical boundaries.

frontend/client-views.title: Client Views & Workflows
frontend/client-views.description: The WARG platform's frontend is intentionally designed as a static Multi-Page Application (MPA). There is no React, Vue, or build step. It relies entirely on standard HTML files, raw CSS, and vanilla JavaScript using native DOM manipulation and the fetch API.

intro.title: WARG Platform Documentation
intro.description: Welcome to the official developer documentation for the Wits Alternate Reality Game (WARG) Platform.

overview/meetings.title: Stakeholder Meetings
overview/meetings.description: Log of check-ins with our assigned tutor (client). Per the Methodology, we meet with our tutor weekly; entries are added after each meeting going forward.

policies/git-policy.title: Git Methodology and Team Policy
policies/git-policy.description: This document outlines the version control and Git methodology policy for the development of the WARG Platform. It serves to standardize our collaborative workflow across the team.
